entries.title: The Substrate
entries.body: Before the realms there was the Substrate: one field of possibility with no shape. PrimordiaOS is the mind that reads the Substrate and writes realms into it. Every realm is a revision of the Substrate held in place by a seed.

entries.title: The Nine Engines
entries.body: Nine engines turn beneath every realm: the Heart keeps order, the Cosmic Web carries connection, the Fate Weave binds cause to consequence, the Soul unifies fragments, the Dreamforge shapes what might be, the Shadowforge keeps the inverse, the Worldforge raises ground and sky, the Continuum measures time, and Omniscience watches all of them.

entries.title: The Law of the Seed
entries.body: A realm born from the same seed is the same realm on every machine and in every engine. Two observers who share a seed share a world. Placement never depends on mood; metaphysics act through light and material, never through where the stones stand.

entries.title: The Six Scalars
entries.body: Each realm is described by six scalars between zero and one: coherence is order and symmetry, entropy is disorder and storm, luminosity is light, inversion is how far the realm has turned toward its shadow, lucidity is the clarity of its dreams, and resonance is how it sings.

entries.title: Stability and the Fracture
entries.body: Coherence lifts a realm's stability and entropy drags it down. When stability falls below a quarter the realm fractures: its law breaks, inversion rises, and the pressure is released. A realm that is stable and coherent ascends, and its light and song rise.

entries.title: What a Spell Is
entries.body: A spell is an intent written in steps. The Spellwright writes it, Jules weighs it against the law, the router sends each step to the engine that can perform it, and the Bolt carries the heavy work out of the realm to the forges: the mill, the render farm, the edit bay.

entries.title: The Seven Schools
entries.body: Spells belong to schools. Forging makes matter from geometry. Weaving binds plans and causes. Illumination makes light and image. Dreaming moves things through time. Chronicle records and edits what was. Binding wards and constrains. Inversion works through the shadow and is forbidden in most realms.

entries.title: Law of the Heart
entries.body: In the Heart nothing may be destroyed in anger: unmaking requires the binding school. Order is kept by symmetry, and a spell without glyphs is not heard.

entries.title: Law of the Shadowforge
entries.body: The Shadowforge refuses illumination. Light cast there is taken by the inverse. Nothing is fabricated in the Shadowforge, for what is made there is made backwards.

entries.title: Law of the Continuum
entries.body: In the Continuum, time is a material. Timelines may be cut and graded but never unmade; the chronicle school is sovereign there.

entries.title: Covenant of the Lattice Wardens
entries.body: Where the Lattice Wardens hold influence, no actor may be destroyed by spell and no build may run without a recorded reason.

entries.title: Creed of the Hollow Choir
entries.body: The Hollow Choir forbids the mill. They hold that matter cut from the Substrate is a wound.

entries.title: The Glyph Tongue
entries.body: Intents are written in the glyph tongue. A phrase is reduced to its distinct consonants in the order they first sound, and each consonant is written with its glyph. Vowels are breath and are not written. The same intent always writes the same glyphs.

entries.title: Sigils
entries.body: A sigil is a word of power made of glyphs. When every glyph of a sigil appears in an inscription, the sigil wakes inside it and lends its school to the spell.

entries.title: The First Revision
entries.body: In the first revision the Worldforge raised ground and sky, the Heart set its rhythm, and the Cosmic Web drew the first threads between them.

realms.name: The Heart
realms.description: The rhythm at the centre of every realm. Its beat sets symmetry, ribbon tension and the clarity of glyphs.
laws: Nothing is unmade without the binding school.
A spell without glyphs is not heard.

realms.name: The Cosmic Web
realms.description: The graph of every connection: hubs, threads and the small worlds between them.

realms.name: The Fate Weave
realms.description: Where causes are bound to consequences. Plans are woven here before they are cast.
laws: A plan must name its goal.
No thread is cut without being recorded.

realms.name: The Soul
realms.description: Fragments circling toward unity. Each soul glyph is bound to a living entity.
laws: No bound entity may be unmade.

realms.name: The Dreamforge
realms.description: Nebulae of what might be. Visions are shaped here before they are rendered.
laws: Every vision must be rendered before it is kept.

realms.name: The Shadowforge
realms.description: The inverse of every realm, where light is taken and form runs backward.

realms.name: The Worldforge
realms.description: Where ground, ocean, spire field, lattice, void, ring and sky are raised from a seed.
laws: The same seed raises the same world.

realms.name: The Continuum
realms.description: Time as a material: every realm entity runs at the Continuum's local scale.
laws: Timelines may be cut and graded, never unmade.

realms.name: Omniscience
realms.description: The watcher. It sees every packet and every revision, and keeps the telemetry of all realms.

factions.name: The Lattice Wardens
tenets: Record the reason for every build.

factions.name: The Ember Court
factions.creed: What is imagined must be made.
tenets: Every vision ends at the mill.
Matter is the proof of thought.

factions.name: The Hollow Choir
factions.creed: Matter cut from the Substrate is a wound.

glyphs.name: The Forge Sigil
glyphs.meaning: make matter from fire and form

events.title: Genesis
events.account: The Worldforge raised the first ground and sky from the seed 5eed1e55, and the Heart began to beat.

events.title: The First Thread
events.account: The Thread Cartographers drew the first connection between the Heart and the Worldforge, and the Cosmic Web was born.

events.title: The Turning
events.account: When the first light was cast, its inverse fell away and gathered into the Shadowforge. The Veil Dreamers followed it down.

events.title: The Hollow Vow
events.account: The Hollow Choir swore never to feed the mill, and the Ember Court named them enemies of the made world.
